summary: Executed backend wallet-auth/public/share regression via pytest and frontend wallet/docs integration checks against public URL. Major blocker found: wallet connect cannot complete because auth challenge rejects browser Origin, which blocks all authenticated flows.

critical.issue: Returns 403 'Request origin not allowed' for browser/public origin, preventing SIWE auth and all private flows.
Unauthenticated protection path currently gated by origin failure first (403), so wallet-auth flow cannot be exercised end-to-end in deployed environment.

ui_bugs.issue: Injected wallet connect attempt surfaces backend error 'Request origin not allowed'; connection cannot proceed to authenticated state.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked at challenge due origin rejection; buy/start/claim/topup/settings/share flows are untestable in public environment because authenticated session cannot be created.

action_items: Fix deployed APP_ORIGIN/origin validation mismatch so browser Origin from https://rwa-incubate.preview.emergentagent.com is accepted by /api/auth/challenge and other protected POST/PATCH routes.
Re-run wallet auth suite after origin fix, then validate workspace isolation, replay/nonce checks, and share-card ownership constraints end-to-end.
After auth fix, re-run UI wallet tests with injected EIP-1193 provider and real cryptographic personal_sign to validate full connect/reconnect/accountsChanged paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Origin check in wallet_auth.py is strict equality against runtime APP_ORIGIN; deployed env appears misaligned with public host, causing systemic auth outage.
Legacy backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_demo_api_regression.py are obsolete for current signed-wallet model and still assume anonymous /api/demo/sessions behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Direct API and browser-injected provider tests both reproduce the same blocker: /api/auth/challenge 403 Request origin not allowed. Docs route and /protocol redirect work; FAQ/anchors and overflow checks passed. Continue from origin fix, then re-run wallet-auth + private-flow + sharing regressions.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/auth/challenge with Origin=https://rwa-incubate.preview.emergentagent.com returns 403; same error appears in UI wallet connect error state. Backend logs confirm repeated 403 on /api/auth/challenge. Likely root cause is runtime APP_ORIGIN mismatch in deployed backend compared to public frontend origin. Mitigation: align APP_ORIGIN with public host (exact scheme+host), redeploy, then revalidate auth/challenge->verify cookie flow.
